---
applyTo: "**/*.ts,**/*.tsx,**/*.js,**/*.jsx"
---

Follow the [canonical policy](../../policy/core.md) and
[Copilot workflow](../../docs/copilot/workflow.md) together with applicable project instructions.

This optional profile adds frontend guidance without assuming React or Next.js.
Read the actual framework, package scripts and applicable project rules. Preserve
interface behavior, keyboard/accessibility paths and responsive layouts. Handle
loading, error and empty states affected by the change. Use project-approved type,
lint, build and behavior checks; document any UI checks not executed. Do not add
libraries, change bundler configuration or replace components outside task scope.
